CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **OpenScrub** — a local, GPU-accelerated video redaction tool. It detects and blurs PII in videos and screen recordings — faces, whole people (silhouette-precise body masking), license plates, and any on-screen text: names, phone numbers, SSNs, emails, addresses, card numbers, or your own regex patterns — with a human review step before anything is trusted. Everything runs on your own hardware; no footage ever leaves your server.
Support: open an issue at https://github.com/austinmabry/OpenScrub/issues
